thread:
Maya: Quick sync — TechSignal pre-brief is Wed 9:00am PT. They asked if we can offer an APAC-friendly staggered embargo window. Also need final benchmark language for the press doc by EOD tomorrow.
Priya: We can do a stagger. What do you mean exactly by 'APAC-friendly'? different lift time or an early access window?
Maya: Thinking early access: APAC reviewers get materials 2 hours earlier than EU/US so they can brief live. So embargo lift would be partial at 10am PT (APAC-only), full lift at 12pm PT. Need eng to sign off on benchmark phrasing so PR doesn't overclaim.
Kyle: Which exact claim? The "2.4x throughput" line is from internal synthetic runs. I can provide the run command and caveats.
Alex: Recommend we phrase as: "up to 2.4x throughput in internal synthetic benchmarks vs our baseline" and include test conditions in the tech note. Avoid implying real-world typical gains.
Jenna: Analyst ops note — TechSignal will want the run commands + dataset description. They'll expect a slide deck by tomorrow afternoon. Can we get embargoed deck to them by 3pm PT?
Maya: Target: runbook by 12:45pm, deck by 3pm PT, legal check on embargo tweak by EOD. Kyle can you deliver the run snippet + short caveats?
Kyle: Yes. Snippet: `redwood-bench --model rdx-3b --batch 8 --seq 512` -> median tps=240 vs baseline 100 => 2.4x. Caveats: synthetic prompts, empty cache, single-GPU config. I'll redact kernel names per legal. ETA 12:45pm.
Priya: Perfect. I'll draft PR copy using Alex's phrasing and placeholder numbers until Kyle confirms.
Maya: @Kyle please include a 1-paragraph note we can paste into the tech note about workload assumptions.
Kyle: Will do. One more caveat: benchmark uses continuous batching and our KV-cache warm path — include that in the note.
Alex: Legal flagged kernel-level details — do not include those. Keep it to flags/commands + aggregate metrics.
Maya: Noted. @press-bot can you create the calendar event + invites for the pre-brief (Wed 9am PT) and a follow-up APAC slot?
press-bot: Calendar event created: "TechSignal pre-brief" Wed 9:00 AM PT. Invitees: Maya, Priya, Jenna, Kyle, Alex. Event ID 78321.
Jenna: Also, confirm whether APAC early access needs any extra NDA language — I'll ping Legal.
Priya: I'll loop Legal now. If they say no changes, we'll proceed with the same embargo + limited recipient list for APAC early access.
Maya: Plan stands: Kyle drops runbook 12:45pm, PR deck by 3pm, Legal confirms embargo tweak by EOD. If green, send embargoed deck to TechSignal and run the APAC briefing.
Alex: :thumbsup:
Kyle: Copy. I'll keep the runbook concise.
Jenna: Thanks all — will prep analyst ops checklist once I have final deck.
Maya: Thanks — moving to action items.
